notes_for_editor: Thin record. The FFLA list names no agency; the Central US page names the Texas Forest Service. Two WebSearch calls found no build, staffing, fire or removal history. The elevation comes from a map database and is approximate; the story gives it as a map-database figure. The Bowman sentence is general East Texas background, not about Redwater. Possible leads for a human: Texas A&M Forest Service archives, Bowie County historical records, and old USGS maps of the Leary quadrangle. No photos found.
